# Once-rounded complete raw MOVE for the selected #6030 source

**Source scope matters.** This theorem binds the selected **#6030** catalogue
retained by the all-source leaf: 22,803 source events, 3,453 raw MOVE
occurrences and 2,886 directed chart pairs. It does not bind the proposed
#6936 arithmetic word (71,144 events and 6,323 MOVEs). Sharing an abstract
operator or ABI does not establish a source/recipe/caller correspondence
between those words. There is no new κ or global assumption discharge.

Canonical base is `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.
Runtime dependencies are the rounded positive wrapper at public
`3a6b01655f9f0893cef52563a63d79b3295bc67d`, the exact direct-MOVE coordinator
at `a61652557fa88cd0b24c1b28445cf519f6b1213e`, and their retained exact
source/serial/cutoff packages. In particular the positive child is deliberately
replaced by public cutoff transport
`785000b8f400609943cd9ff04843317af4ae67a4`. The existing coordinator's
computational bytes are unchanged; its old f-only child is not secretly
claimed equivalent on a larger domain. This new supplier substitution is
part of the theorem below. DEPENDENCIES.json authenticates all retained
files; SHARED-SOURCE-JOIN.json checks the 109 reused serial-source identities.

## 1. Precise domain and result

Fix one exact typed raw selected #6030 entrance/PAID/exit triple admitted by
the unchanged catalogue. Its positive rank is r in {1,...,8}; both monomial
recipes have nine vectors. Fix positive parent column width f and retain
the direct-branch premise **f<=t**, where t is the original cutoff. This
claim does not cover f>t through an invented cutoff change.

Write H,G,K,u,z,a for the parent's reserved H, spacing G, chunk K,
active_start, back_start and within_bits. Retain the complete source geometry:

    H,G,K >= 1; 0 <= rho < K; 0 <= e < 9;
    (f-1)G <= H; 2H <= u;
    u+9fK <= z; z+H <= a;
    selected_axes = 9f+e <= d.

The original header is canonical, all positive extents are positive, and
every complete row has exactly 2^a records. There are c>=1 complex
coefficients per record, each real/imaginary component encoded in h>=2
two's-complement bits followed by delimiter 2. Virtual symbols retain the
current three-bit physical code. Thus, with B=outer*rows,

    b=6c(h+1), row_bits=2^a b, V=B 2^a b.

All supplied work roles are initially blank at their current local origins;
the public field, descriptor, every owned role and protected caller ancestor
are genuinely disjoint as required by the predecessors. Fixed ordinary
constructors satisfy the retained type, closed-state and no-observer
contracts. They are actually constructed and charged even though no
ordinary numerical invocation occurs on this serialized direct route.
Every source/physical return premise of the retained exact providers remains
explicit. The new orchestration is a source-level finite-control refinement,
not a new flattened compiler theorem.

Let U be the exact original source Clifford map, including its absolute
phase, on all 9f native coordinates and every spectator, row and coefficient.
Let Delta=2^-F be the original common component grid; F is a scale annotation,
not an absent header field. Input numerators are arbitrary signed h-bit
integers. Put g=rf and

    sigma=ceil((g+1)/2)+1,  w=h+g+sigma.

The completed provider returns exactly the componentwise function

    R_Delta(Ux)=Delta * floor(Ux/Delta+1/2)

if all rounded components fit the original h-bit range. It raises the
explicit final `RoundedOverflow`, preserving the entire public input, if
any one does not fit. For the stated valid geometry/physical provider domain,
there is no extra divisibility or intermediate signed-headroom admission.

For totality with an error bound, use a complete containing X-fibre which
contains **all 9f native axes**, not merely the g Gaussian axes. If its
actual input norm is at most R and

    R+Delta/2 < 2^(h-1) Delta,

then the final output fits and the primitive is total, with

    ||R_Delta(Ux)-Ux||_X <= 2^((X-1)/2) Delta = eta_X.

No ideal-input, input correlation, empty-helper or intermediate zero-error
premise is used. This is a local raw-MOVE contract; caller placement,
recursive/nonleaf admission, global precision and analytic recovery remain
unproved here.

## 2. Exact source, shared objects and the four descriptors

The inherited source certificate identifies

    U = L (C on g selected axes) R,
    C = (1/2) [[1+i,1-i],[1-i,1+i]].

Here the physically executed entrance is the recorded right monomial R and
the exit is the recorded left monomial L. The selected catalogue binds the
actual owner, raw token, rank and chronology. It does not erase nested
remaps, replace expanded caller fragments, or accept a different #6936
triple merely because it has the same spelling.

`rounded_move_sources.py` first activates the frozen rounded-leaf closure.
The authenticated serial discovery shim points to exactly those monomial,
row, Count, Tape, codec and ABI objects. The unchanged direct coordinator
then receives that serial provider, the same catalogue and ABI, and the
explicit private-cutoff positive child. No duplicate Count/Tape classes,
alternate tape alphabet or numerical callback is installed. These objects
are fixed before input binding and remain fixed throughout the call.

The descriptor lifetimes and permissions are:

| Descriptor | Numerical width and physical sizes | Geometry/control changes | Consumer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original P | h; b and row_bits | none | outer lift/setup and final return |
| Widened P_w | w; b'=6c(w+1), row_bits'=2^a b' | other 21 fields unchanged, including f,t | direct coordinator, both serial view builders, positive view builder |
| Serial column j | w and the same full b',row_bits' | f'=1,K'=fK,rho'=rho+jK, selected_axes'=9+e | one actual monomial call |
| Positive view | w and the same full b',row_bits' | f'=rf,cutoff'=rt only | exact positive numeric leaf |

The previous rounded-leaf package restricted P_w to its leaf use. The next

The outer wrapper computes g from the original f. P_w retains that f;

## 3. Every serial consumer accepts the widened physical parent

First, widening changes no logical address coordinate. The literal serial
builder reads the same f,K,rho,e and emits the same column geometry. Its
arithmetic fK and rho+jK, loop bounds, finite rank9 constant and cleanup
are unchanged. The two enlarged physical length values are canonically
copied into every column view, including the last one.

The unchanged signed monomial `prepare` scans the actual first component,
so it now obtains w. Its only h-dependent record equation is
`record_bits=6c(h+1)`. With the physical b' it recovers exactly c. It checks
`row_bits=2^a record_bits`, which holds with row_bits'. Every other geometric
test is independent of numerical component length and is the old serial
identity: f'=1 gives n'=0, used compact extent zero and full reserved H
still present; all nine vector slots have width fK; the source offsets
select exactly `u+(if+j)K+rho`; before/after intervals and the untouched
ordinary remainder stay the same.

The complete suffix after z is folded into coefficients. For the one-column
call, its number is `c*2^(a-z)`, exactly as before widening; its physical
record width is now `2w*c*2^(a-z)` old numerical symbols. The number of
enumerated prefix records remains `B*2^z`. Their product is the complete
stripped numerical field `2w c B 2^a`. No reserved suffix or coefficient is
discarded to make the view fit. The current coded field is correspondingly
`V'=6c(w+1)B2^a` physical bits.

The engine's subsequent width consumers use this actual w in the signed
phase scan, record layout, complete copying, digit permutations and export.
Its only component-width lower guard is w>=2. The numerical monomial
operations are coefficient permutations and multiplications by ±1 or ±i;
they do not create a new hidden denominator. The n'=0 branch uses literal
one-column digit gates, not ordinary or Compact numerical invocations.
The complete normalization/format and private-return contracts are the same
retained ones. The metadata checker actually executes both serial tables
and both monomial `prepare` methods, for every tested column, at ranks1,2,8
and f1/2 with multiplicities; it does not substitute a Python header oracle
for those consumers.

The positive child's own exact record and row checks recover c and the
same complete rows at w. It receives g=rf, the original K and rho, and
selects the first r native blocks across all f columns. The parent
inequality u+9fK<=z<=a implies u+rfK<=a. Its unchanged guard compares
rf<=rt, equivalent to the original positive f<=t. Thus all three factors
consume physically correct widened words under their actual local guards.

## 4. All exact numerical prefixes fit

The paid outer codec emits g low zeros, the original h bits and sigma sign
copies for every component, preserving every delimiter and the complete
field. It represents `2^g m` on grid Delta/2^g, not an unpriced reinterpretation.

The entrance monomial and all its serialized intermediate phase/permutation
steps preserve the absolute value of each real/imaginary component, up to
swapping components. Their magnitude is at most `2^(h+g-1)`, strictly below
the widened signed boundary because sigma>=2. Consequently an entrance
negation can never encounter the widened most-negative word. This closes
the serial predecessor's narrower signed-domain issue, including temporary
sign changes which could cancel only after later columns.

After entrance, every component is still divisible by 2^g. Each positive
Gaussian stage divides a signed integer linear combination by two, so after
j stages every component is divisible by `2^(g-j)`. All g halves are exact.
For the stored-output bound, any complete g-axis fibre after entrance has
2^(g+1) real components bounded by `2^(h+g-1)`. Every Gaussian prefix is
unitary, giving

    |stored component| <= 2^(h+g+(g-1)/2) <= 2^(w-2).

This internal bound uses only the g mixing axes. It is valid even though
the full operator/error fibre must contain all 9f axes: entrance can
permute values between different g-fibres, but each entry still satisfies
the same component bound. The argument does not assume that entrance
preserves a particular smaller g-fibre norm.

The inherited fused Gaussian arithmetic uses bounded carry rather than
storing a potentially larger four-term numerator in w bits; the bound
above is exactly its stored-output obligation. The exit monomial again
only permutes components and applies unit phases. Its every serialized
intermediate has magnitude at most `2^(w-2)`, so it too cannot hit the
widened most-negative word. All source prefixes therefore meet the larger
**exact-prefix** domain of the direct-MOVE theorem. We do not claim they
satisfy that predecessor's stronger sufficient L1/divisibility envelope.

The complete exact coordinator returns precisely `2^g U(m)` in the widened
field, with original absolute phase. Its positive child is exact; there is
no intermediate rounding. Only after its exit and protected inner commit
does the inherited dynamic-g drop run. The previous codec proof establishes
`floor(z/2^g+1/2)` for every signed z, negative ties included, and checks
the entire signed extension. Hence the outer final result is exactly
R_Delta(Ux), and its only numerical rejection on the valid source/shape
domain is true final h-bit output overflow.

## 5. Final rounding, error domain and source counterexamples

All 9f axes participate in the full monomial/C/monomial map. On a complete
X-fibre containing them, U is unitary. For an actual input radius R, every
ideal output component has magnitude at most R. One final componentwise
round contributes at most Delta/2. The stated strict radius condition
therefore guarantees signed fit and totality. There are 2^(X+1) real
components, so the squared residual is at most `2^(X-1) Delta^2`, proving
eta_X. This uses the actual input to the completed call, including errors
from any earlier computation, without identifying it with an ideal vector.

Upward rounding does not commute with a negative unit phase. We retain an
exact selected #6030 discriminator rather than relying only on a generic
example. At raw event9896, owner236, rank1, logical basis0 input (1,0),
the original source's output21 is `(1/2,-1/2)`. Rounding after the complete
exit gives `(1,0)`; rounding immediately after the positive child and then
performing the exit gives `(0,-1)`. All512 logical outputs are compared
using the predecessor's independent original-circuit integer evaluator,
not the production tape kernels.

A second bounded witness for the same source shows premature overflow.
Prepare the right-monomial preimage of a vector supported on middle
addresses1 and0 with values `(1,0)` and `(1,1)`. Every original input fits
h=2. The positive child's early rounded pair at address1 is `(2,1)`, which
does not fit; nevertheless every once-rounded complete original-source
output fits h=2. The checker finds this at the third of at most16 specified
candidates and verifies the complete source factorization. It does not
claim the stricter radius sufficient condition for this witness. Both
counterexamples are exact finite source algebra, not physical whole-MOVE
executions or general impossibility theorems.

## 6. Ownership, call order and full inventory

The exact direct coordinator retains its own protected widened stage. The
outer protection is not used to silently delete that stage or its invoice.
The life order is: outer lift and header construction; complete exact
entrance, positive child and exit; inner commit/retirement; sole final grid
drop into the original-width stage; final public commit; retirement.

The source activation and port attachment are completed before numerical
inputs are inspected. `ExactMoveChild` accepts only the same prebound field
and context. The outer Count/codec scopes are suspended while the exact
coordinator and its providers run; the shared global codec is never nested.
Live outer Count leases occupy distinct fixed roles throughout. On return
the outer scope resumes for rounding and its own cleanup.

| Fixed cohort | Ports |
|---|---:|
| Outer expanded field, rounded output, widened descriptor | 3 |
| Outer metadata and two parser guides | 130 |
| Inner protected complete widened stage | 1 |
| Two serial descriptor banks | 90 |
| Positive cutoff and exact numeric child | 388 |
| Two complete monomial cohorts | Q_R+Q_L |
| **Total** | **612+Q_R+Q_L** |

The actual q2/capacity64 constructors give Q_R=Q_L=1878, hence4368 roles.
Different admitted fixed factories retain their actual sizes and costs.
No unused ordinary object or its marker/backing inventory is deleted.

Before final commit, the original field is untouched. A named valid returned
factor rejection first retires the inner stage, then unwinds the outer live
counts and its stages. A true late final overflow occurs only after the
exact inner job has returned; it similarly retires the partial rounded
stage without a public write. Borrowed header bytes and caller ancestors
remain intact, and every owned role returns blank at its current origin.
These claims inherit the providers' valid-return/cleanup contracts. They
exclude interruption, malformed input or late output, hidden overlap and
providers violating their stated return obligations.

## 7. Complete expanded invoice and historical backing

Let E be the original binary descriptor length, Ew the widened parent length
and V'=V(w+1)/(h+1). From the unchanged outer codec proof,

    Ew <= E+4 ceil(log2((w+1)/(h+1))) = O(E+1).

The positive view adds at most12 more physical bits. The two serial view
loops cost H_R+H_L=O_9(f(Ew+1)); their current descriptor lengths are O(Ew+1).
Their columns are genuinely repeated complete calls, not one free batch.
Let P_R,j and P_L,j include every actual one-column codec, source access,
phase/permutation, copy, encoded control, restoration and cleanup action.
Let T_C be the full widened positive numeric bill and H_C the literal
cutoff-view bill (`H_C<=2000Ew+20000`). The exact inner invoice is

    F_inner + H_R+H_L + sum_j(P_R,j+P_L,j)
            + H_C + T_C(g,V',w,Echild) + 22V'+35.

The unchanged administrative coefficients are transfer8V'+14,
commit9V'+14 and retire5V'+7. On a named valid returned inner failure the
administrative subtotal is13V'+21, plus every actually attempted provider
and descriptor operation. The outer invoice additionally charges its
complete lift, drop, encoded setup, original-width commit9V+14, both outer
numeric stages, widened descriptor, count markers and erasure.

For the explicit unabsorbed one-column ceiling, write

    R1'=2wc*2^(a-z),  M1=B*2^z,  Vraw'=M1*R1',
    A1'=2+z+ceil(log2(R1'+1)).

Vraw' is stripped old numerical length; it is not confused with the current
coded V'. Let d_R,d_L count the fixed affine gates in the exact recipes.
The complete upper envelope retains

    F_template
      + O_9(f*((d_R+d_L+2)*(Vraw'+M1*(A1')^6)
                         + V'+(Ew+1)^4+Q_R+Q_L)
             + gV'+(Ew+13)^4+Q_total+V')
      + 22V'+35 + 9V+14.

F_template includes all exact source authentication/delivery, fixed recipe
and table compilation, the real closed ordinary constructors, complete
fixed inventories and program storage. Outer codec/source/header passes
are O(V'+(E+1)^4+130) with their explicit retained physical-code factors;
the positive leaf is charged at expanded V', not the original field size.
Every newly reached body/frontier cell and owned cleanup is paid. No factor,
restoration, retained stage, recursive helper assumption or failed work is
assigned zero cost.

Only with the additional **expanded** long-record hypothesis
`R1'>=(A1')^6` and control absorption `(Ew+13)^4+Q_total=O(V')` does the
fixed source/gate/rank regime simplify to `F_template+O(fV')`.
The old h-width hypothesis is not silently substituted for this w-width
condition. Separately, `g<=h` implies `V'<=3V`; without such an expansion
bound the ratio is unbounded. Neither simplification is a faster nonleaf
tariff or a complete multiplication exponent improvement.

The precision56bc938 formula `W=p+h_guard+2D+3+g_small` gives only the
conditional arithmetic implication: if a separately established source and
parameter correspondence identifies this h with W and places all9f native
axes inside X<=D, then g=rf<=9f<=D<W=h. It does not establish that binding
for this selected #6030 source, nor transfer the proposed #6936 global
precision theorem or its S1--S5 premises.

For backing, retain both full expanded stages, the original-width rounded
stage, all descriptors and every monomial/positive/outer cohort. Add each
predecessor's full per-role backing envelope at the widened arguments; no
long-record or occupied-content simplification removes visited storage.
Across completed calls, charge `sum_i max_k(origin_i(k)+B_i(k))`, including
previous history and borrowed ancestor storage. The maxima of distinct roles
can occur on distinct calls. Outer counts remain live while inner roles are

## 8. Evidence and execution boundary

The geometry proves `a>=3H+9fK>=12`. Thus every admitted full MOVE has at
least4096 records and V>=73,728 bits; even the minimal lifted width has
w>=5 and V'>=147,456 bits. The earlier exact direct-MOVE fixture at this
minimum took815.504 seconds before widening. A finite census of all3453
source occurrences also found that its event13096 ties event13222 for the
minimum combined affine-gate count4. This is a gate metric, not a proof of
minimum host runtime across all inputs/recipes.

No new complete numerical whole-MOVE run was attempted. Under the explicit
120-second/no-repeat budget, there is no smaller admitted packet to use.
The recorded larger **structural-only** codec/admin attempt lost its session
during parent interruption and produced no receipt; no observed exit status,
timeout status or success is invented. It is not repeated.

Six metadata cases execute actual literal serial/cutoff tables and actual
monomial/positive preparation consumers. They do not materialize the complete
declared numeric fields. The tiny call-order and failure controls explicitly
replace all three numerical factor methods, use a shape **outside** the
nine-block domain, and are labelled structural instrumentation. They execute
the actual outer lift/drop and both protected coordinators, checking success,
named rejection, late overflow and all4368-role retirement. They are not
numerical MOVE evidence. The source counterexamples are exact algebraic
checks, separately labelled. The universal result is the stated reviewed
composition of authenticated provider contracts, not an extrapolation of
these controls.
